candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to betLimit plus the input amount (so AdjustBetAmounts increases limit instead of setting it).
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to amount + 1 (so AdjustBetAmounts sets limit to amount+1 instead of amount).
Modify onlyOwner modifier to check msg.sender != owner (inverting the check) which will change who can call AdjustBetAmounts and thus change observable betLimit after calls by legitimate owner.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to amount * 2 (so AdjustBetAmounts doubles the provided amount when setting betLimit).
AdjustDifficulty now sets difficulty to amount + 1 instead of amount, changing the stored difficulty value.
AdjustDifficulty now sets difficulty to amount - 1 instead of amount, changing the stored difficulty value (underflow prevented by solidity >=0.8 will revert if amount == 0).
AdjustDifficulty now increments difficulty by amount rather than replacing it, changing the resulting difficulty.
AdjustDifficulty now divides amount by 2 and assigns that to difficulty, producing a different stored difficulty.
onlyOwner modifier now requires msg.sender != owner instead of equality, allowing non-owners to call AdjustDifficulty and thus potentially change difficulty differently.
Changed OpenToThePublic to set openToPublic = false instead of true, flipping the state after call.
Modified onlyOwner modifier to invert the check so the caller must NOT be the owner, altering who can open to public.
